title: Match replays
body: Planned for a later update. Record every match (soldier positions, aim, weapons, shots, flags, kills) at ~15 Hz into user://replays/ (compressed, a few MB per round), and a REPLAYS screen to watch them back with play/pause, speed and a free camera / follow-player view. The same buffer can turn the kill cam into a real rewind of the last few seconds.

title: Discord Rich Presence
body: Planned for a later update. Show "Playing CTF on Ascent, 7/12" with a join button in Discord. Needs a Discord application id (Discord developer portal) and the Discord IPC / a GDExtension on Windows.

title: itch.io page
body: Planned for a later update. Store page (description, screenshots, GIFs, controls) with the Windows build and the Android APK, so new players can find the game. Steam later if it catches on.
